currentContract: Effect is Hit.name from the same existing combined AvidEffects::lookup as Effect Category. Shared post-selection code is gated by selected Precompute Type and an available selected Clip Name observation. OMF supplies already-agreed selected-master name/Type facts; there is no second Effect property or parser.

A recognised token yields the first indexed canonical English display name. Known localized spellings and the explicit3DWarp alias select the same English name. Exact case, catalogue spellings and aliases are preserved; a category ambiguity does not replace that existing first-name rule.

An unrecognised nonempty extracted token is retained verbatim, including case, underscores, whitespace and spelling. It is the parsed token, not an invented filename or alternate master/source name. No global underscore replacement, title-casing, trimming or fuzzy match is applied.

For confirmed Precompute, empty/unavailable Effect is displayed/exported as lowercaseunknown. Ordinary Media and unknownType areblank. An unavailable Effect Category or parent Precompute Category does not discard valid Effect text; name recognition does not establish Type or either category.

Both existing suffix forms and their precedence stay unchanged: complete valid commaN[.new.N...] chain determines preceding effect boundary first; otherwise terminal+N is tried. Every decimal component must fit signedint range; zero is allowed. Malformed/overflowing suffixes remain in the extracted token. Commas inside preceding sequence name remain meaningful boundary context.

The existing resolver already uses anchored static regular expressions and one lazy shared catalogue index. Current matching may derive more than once as selected Type/name changes; one lookup supplies all companion outputs per pass, not necessarily once per current scan.

Current row owns QString Effect and table/CSV/Search/filter use shared display labels. Optional presentation controls do not mean current derivation has an internal feature guard; proposed request gating/lifetimes are integration choices, not demonstrated savings.

The legacy helper temporarily returns sequence/instance/matched fields. Bella can ignore/discard them after the shared call, retaining only agreed Effect/Effect Category and necessary derived context. No Effect Sequence row/result/CSV field is reintroduced.
minimumBellaUse: Use the same approved final selected Type/name derivation outside OMF byte parsing, with existing catalogue/resolver unchanged. One shared lookup for requested Precompute details supplies Effect and Effect Category; no new Effect-only lookup/index, suffix parser or source graph.

Keep Hit.name as an ownedQString, reuse the combined result for rows sharing selected master/name while processing, and derive again when final selected inputs change. Normal Qt implicit sharing suffices; no permanent every-name cache or interner.

Preserve canonical English first-match, localized/compatibility aliases, raw unmatched token, lowercaseunknown for empty/unavailable Precompute and blank for otherTypes. Category/Type independence remains unchanged.

Discard transient legacy Sequence/instance/matched outputs after use. Preserve suffix-boundary behavior without retaining Sequence as metadata. No registry/plugin/effect-parameter load or media open is needed.

No new ownership/text rule, sourcepriority/opening/scheduling policy, Type/Precompute Category/Compression behavior, visible column or BinFilter change. No measured speed/memory/reliability gain claimed.

"""Curate the OMF Effect companion review; no media or runtime execution."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/martymclean/Developer/MediaMuster')
CACHE, VERIFIED, MISSING = {}, {}, []


def digest(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if str(p) not in CACHE:
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with p.open('rb') as stream:
            for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                h.update(block)
        CACHE[str(p)] = h.hexdigest()
    return CACHE[str(p)]


def record(path):
    p = Path(path)
    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': digest(p)}


def check(path, expected, context):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute():
        p = ROOT / p
    if not p.is_file():
        MISSING.append({'path': str(p), 'expectedSha256': expected, 'context': context})
        return
    assert digest(p) == expected, (context, str(p))
    VERIFIED[str(p)] = record(p)


def walk(value, context):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for pk, hk in [('path', 'sha256'), ('artifact', 'artifactSha256'),
                       ('resolvedArtifact', 'resolvedArtifactSha256'),
                       ('metadataSource', 'metadataSourceSha256'),
                       ('classBlockPath', 'classBlockSha256')]:
            if isinstance(value.get(pk), str) and isinstance(value.get(hk), str):
                check(value[pk], value[hk], context)
        for key, child in value.items():
            if context == 'current' and key == 'sourceAnchors':
                continue  # These hashes cover excerpts, not the whole file.
            walk(child, context + '/' + str(key))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for i, child in enumerate(value):
            walk(child, context + '/' + str(i))


expected = {
    'current': '8da9ae31ebd92c27faf697afeedd78949e2aa3e690aebf910fc50a001f2236c1',
    'mc': 'da94a4833b395a1fbff2861b25e6c6a0a1b83b29ebecd9f2d6d8e09983f71fa8',
    'mdvx': 'e7a8bd486a2fd43c41c975f512c8bade982e713682bde11e8739e2769b6150c7',
}
receipts, receipt_files = {}, {}
for who, expected_hash in expected.items():
    p = Path(f'/private/tmp/bella-omf-effect-{who}-20261025/findings.json')
    assert digest(p) == expected_hash
    receipt_files[who] = record(p)
    receipts[who] = json.loads(p.read_text())
    walk(receipts[who], who)
assert not MISSING, MISSING

current = receipts['current']
assert len(current['sourceInputs']) == 8 and len(current['sourceAnchors']) == 12
for item in current['sourceInputs']:
    p = Path(item['path'])
    relative = str(p.relative_to(ROOT))
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + relative], cwd=ROOT) == p.read_bytes()
for anchor in current['sourceAnchors']:
    excerpt = ''.join(Path(anchor['path']).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)[anchor['startLine']-1:anchor['endLine']])
    assert excerpt == anchor['text']
    assert hashlib.sha256(excerpt.encode()).hexdigest() == anchor['sha256']

mdvx = receipts['mdvx']
with Path(mdvx['binary']['path']).open('rb') as stream:
    for method in mdvx['reusedFunctions']:
        stream.seek(method['binaryOffset'])
        raw = stream.read(method['codeBytes'])
        assert len(raw) == method['codeBytes']
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == method['codeSha256']
    table = mdvx['reverifiedUsageData']
    stream.seek(table['tableFileOffset'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(stream.read(table['bytes'])).hexdigest() == table['sha256']
    for label in table['labels']:
        stream.seek(label['cfStringFileOffset'])
        assert hashlib.sha256(stream.read(32)).hexdigest() == label['cfStringBytesSha256']
        stream.seek(label['charactersFileOffset'])
        raw = stream.read(label['charactersBytes'])
        assert raw == label['text'].encode('ascii')
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == label['charactersSha256']
assert len(mdvx['reusedFunctions']) == 14 and len(table['labels']) == 15
assert receipts['mc']['method']['freshDisassembly'] is False
assert len(receipts['mc']['extantRawFreshlyHashed']) == 6

approval_path = ROOT / 'Project Bella/evidence/omf-effect-category-plan-2026-10-25.json'
approval = json.loads(approval_path.read_text())
research = approval['researchAtApproval']
check(research['path'], research['sha256'], 'effectCategoryApproval/research')
type_path = ROOT / 'Project Bella/evidence/omf-type-2026-10-25.json'
types = json.loads(type_path.read_text())
examples = current['reusedActualMetadata']['examples']
assert len(examples) == 5
for example in examples:
    assert example['selectedMasterUsage'] == 7 and example['effectCategoryApplicable'] is False
    previous = next(e for e in types['reusedOwnMetadata']['examples'] if e['path'] == example['path'])
    assert previous['masterUsage'] == 7 and previous['selectedMasterObject'] == example['masterObject']

draft_path = ROOT / 'docs/reviews/2026-10-23-bella-omf/effect.md'
draft_hash = '075528f908a1038f6aaa46c6eee5f09a84db0b81b2a16ee9192a6b92d5777f78'
